power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_starti: Awụsa ya na anyụike igwe anaghị agbaji II.
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.name: Onye oji
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.desc: Onye na-emepụta ihe na-arụ ọrụ nke akụrụngwa ya dị elu na nke nrụzi ya na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_repair: Nrụzi Anvil na-eri obere ihe ma weghachikwu ogologo ndụ.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_forge_: Aka efu na-agbaji okwute dị ka okwute pickaxe.
Na-enweta mmebi ọkara site na ọkụ, lava, magma, na ọkụ - akpụkpọ anụ siri ike.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_starti: Spawn na 4 ígwè ingots iji malite azu.
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.name: Esi nri
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.descriptio: Ọkachamara na-eri nri nke nri emebere na-akawanye mma yana onye na-enweta ego XP site na ise siga.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.name: Ezi nri
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.descrip: Nri ị rụpụtara na-enye oke agụụ na saturation.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_seasoned_pal: Mmetụta ọgwụ n'ahụ gị na-adịru 25% ogologo oge.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.name: Mma Cook
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.descri: Spawn na mma agha ígwè - onye osi nri ọ bụla chọrọ ezigbo agụba.
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.name: Onye ahịa
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.descri: Onye ahịa nke maara ihe nke onye obodo ya na-azụ ahịa anaghị agwụ agwụ, onye na-ahụkwa ngwa ahịa dị ụkọ n'aka ndị ahịa na-awagharị awagharị.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_trades.d: Azụmaahịa ndị obodo anaghị agwụcha gị.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_rare_loo: Ndị na-ere ahịa na-awagharị awagharị na-enye gị azụmaahịa nke ndị obodo na ohere nke akụ na-adịghị ahụkebe.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_starting: Jiri emerald wụsa mkpụrụ ahịa mbụ gị.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_silver_t: Mmetụta ọgwụ n'ahụ gị na-adịte aka 15% - ọbịa na-adịte aka.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_lucky_tr: +1 chioma - ihe ọma na-achọta ezigbo onye na-agba ọsọ.
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.name: Ụkọchukwu
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.descript: Ọkammụta dị nsọ nke nwere ikike ịma mma emelitere yana ogologo oge ogwu.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_enchanting: Tebụl na-atọ ụtọ na-enye mgbaasị kacha mma nso gị.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_potions.de: Mmetụta potion niile na-adịru okpukpu abụọ.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_turn_undea: Ọkụ na-anwụghị na-ahapụ ha adịghị ike maka sekọnd 4.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_divine_sig: Na-ahụ n'ụzọ doro anya na obere ìhè - onyinye si n'elu.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_starting_b: Jiri akwụkwọ a na-ede ede maka ekpere na ndetu.
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.name: Nitwit
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.descript: Ọ dịghị mma karịsịa na ihe ọ bụla. Mgbe ụfọdụ ụzọ kacha mfe bụ nke ziri ezi.
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.name: Onye na-akụ azụ̀
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.descript: Ndụ na nsọtụ mmiri - na-adọta chioma site na tides, na-egwu mmiri dị ka akara, na-amalite na mkpanaka gọziri agọzi.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_waters_luc: +1 ihuoma mgbe ị nọ na mmiri - ebili mmiri na-amasị gị.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_swim_speed: + 15% ọsọ ngagharị mgbe ọ nọ na mmiri.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_sea_legs.d: Ọkara mmiri riri mmebi - ngụgụ agba nkịtị ka miri emi.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_starting_r: E ji mkpanaka ịkụ azụ mara ya na Luck of the Sea I na Lure I.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_night_sigh: Na-enweta ọhụụ abalị mgbe ọ nọ n'okpuru mmiri.
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.name: Mason
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.descripti: Nkume na-amịpụta aka na-eme aka - na-agbaji ngwa ngwa, ọbụ aka a na-akpọ na-ebu agha ahụ, na ị ga-enweta ya mgbe niile.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_stone_hands: Aka efu na-agbaji okwute dị ka okwute pickaxe.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_strong_grip: +1 ekike agha sitere n’oge ndụ ejighi ya.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_starting_pi: Spawn na arụmọrụ I nkume pickaxe.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_block_reach: + 1 ngọngọ ebe a na-erute - ogwe aka mason maara ebe mgbidi ahụ kwụsịrị.
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.name: Paladin
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.descrip: Onye agha dị nsọ - onye na-anwụghị anwụ na-emetụ aka, akpọnwụ enweghị ike ijide, ìhè ọkụ ọkụ na-agwọkwa ọnya.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_turn_unde: Ọkụ na-anwụghị na-ahapụ ha adịghị ike maka sekọnd 4.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_beacon_re: Na-emegharị nwayọ nwayọ ka ọ nọ n'ime ngọngọ 8 nke mgbama.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_starting_: Spawn na Smite I mma agha.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_effect_im: Ihe na-egbochi akpọnwụ - ọrịa ahụ enweghị ike imetụ gị aka.
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.name: Necromancer
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.descripti: Nna-ukwu nke ọnwụ na-enye iwu undead minions - ọkpụkpụ akpọnwụ na ndị na-agba ụta na-alụ ọgụ n'akụkụ gị, mana ike ndụ gị bụ nke ha.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_with: Kpọọ ọkpụkpụ akpọnwụ ka ọ lụọ ọgụ maka gị. Max 2 ozugbo. Ọ na-efu 6 isi. 30-nkeji oyi. Ị ga-emebi 1 ma ọ bụrụ na ọ nwụọ na ọgụ.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_skel: Kpọọ onye na-agba ụta ka ọ lụọ ọgụ maka gị. Max 3 ozugbo. Ọ na-efu 4 isi. 20-nkeji oyi. Ị ga-emebi 1 ma ọ bụrụ na ọ nwụọ na ọgụ.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_entity_grou: Nkewa dị ka anwụghị anwụ. Ahụ ike ozugbo merụọ ya, mmerụ ngwa ngwa gwọọ ya, nsi anaghị emetụta ya. Ọ dị mfe igbu.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_water_breat: Ọ dịghị mkpa iku ume. Nwere ike ịdị ndụ ruo mgbe ebighị ebi n'okpuru mmiri.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_night_visio: Enwere ike ịhụ nke ọma n'ọchịchịrị zuru oke. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.necromancer_daylight_da: Na-enweta mmebi 1.5 kwa nkeji mgbe ìhè anyanwụ na-ekpughere ya.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_reduced_hea: -3 obi (-6 max HP). Ahụ́ nke anwansi ọnwụ kpara akpa.
A na-ebelata nrụpụta ahụike eke ka ọ bụrụ 40% nke nkịtị.
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.name: Gorgon
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.description: Nnukwu anụ ọhịa nwere akpụkpọ anụ nke anya ya na-adọrọ mmasị na nke aka ya na-akụjisị - ma ịdị arọ nke nkume na-ebelata nzọụkwụ ọ bụla.
Na-eme ka ndị iro niile dị nso na Slowness V. Na-eri ume 3. 15-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_stone_fists.name: Nkume aka
power.neoorigins.gorgon_granite_hide.des: Nguzogide na-adịgide adịgide I - akpụkpọ nkume na-eme ka mmetụta ọ bụla dị nro.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_heavy_frame.name: Na-atụgharị uche
power.neoorigins.gorgon_size.name: Na-amanye nnukwu
power.neoorigins.gorgon_size.description: 15% buru ibu karịa onye ọkpụkpọ nkịtị.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_hunger_drain.des: Na-agba ume 50% ngwa ngwa - idobe ụdị nkume na-agwụ ike.
origins.neoorigins.automaton.name: Akpaaka
origins.neoorigins.automaton.description: Ihe eji arụ ọrụ nke na-adịghị eri mmiri ma ọ bụ agụụ na-agụ - mana ọgwụgwọ potions fizzle, mgbake eke bụ glacial, na nzọụkwụ ọ bụla dị arọ.
power.neoorigins.automaton_iron_frame.de: Nguzogide na-adịgide adịgide nke m - etiti ígwè siri ike adịghị emerụ ahụ.
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.name: Chassis mechiri emechi
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.desc: Ọ dịghị mkpa iku ume. Enweghị ike iri mmiri.
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_hunger.des: Agaghị agụ agụụ. Na-agba ọsọ na isi iyi ike dị n'ime.
power.neoorigins.automaton_hide_hunger_b: A na-ezobe mmanya agụụ - automatons anaghị eri nri.
A na-ezobe ogwe ikuku - akpaghị aka anaghị eku ume.
power.neoorigins.automaton_potion_resist: Na-egbochi mmụgharị, ahụike ozugbo, na nsị. Mmetụta potion ndị ọzọ ka na-emetụta.
Ihe mmetụta anya arụnyere arụnyere na-enye ohere ọhụụ doro anya n'ọchịchịrị. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.automaton_heavy_chassis: Na-emegharị 15% nwayọ - etiti dị arọ, nzọụkwụ dị arọ.
Ọgwụgwọ eke na-agba ọsọ na 25% ọnụego - ewuru ka ọ tachie obi, ọ bụghị ịgbake.
origins.neoorigins.kraken.name: Kraken
origins.neoorigins.kraken.description: Nnukwu anụ ọhịa dị omimi nke a mụrụ n'oké osimiri mepere emepe - mmiri dị n'okpuru mmiri na-emebi emebi nke nwere lashes tentacle, gbaa ink, na ndị nlekọta akpọrọ, mana ọ nọ n'akụkụ osimiri, anwụ gbara ọkụ ma kpọọ nkụ n'elu.
power.neoorigins.kraken_tentacle_lash.de: Na-agba ọkụ ndò nke na-ekpuchi anya ma na-ebelata ndị iro niile na radius 6-block. Ọ na-efu 2 isi. 6-nke abụọ cooldown.
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.name: Ink gbaa
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.descrip: Na-agba ọkụ nke ink gbadoro anya nke na-eme ka ndị iro daa ngwa ngwa n'ime oghere 5-block. Ọ na-efu 2 isi. 8-nkeji nke abụọ.
Na-eku ume n'okpuru mmiri ruo mgbe ebighị ebi ma na-ahụ nke ọma site na mmiri na-enweghị foogu.
